rendered: The table's row for Section 6 – Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes (i.e.[1] names the cathode NMC 811[2]. In the ORNL study, that cathode (2.2 mA h/cm^2[3] areal loading) maintaining 80% capacity at 6C charging rate[4]. The corresponding NMC 532[5] and NMC 622[6] cathodes (2.4[7] mA h/cm^2 loading) only retained 49% and 56% capacity, respectively, at 6C rate[8]. So at the 6C[9] rate, the NMC 811[10] cathode kept about 80%[11] of its capacity, versus 49%[12] for NMC 532[13] and 56%[14] for NMC 622[15].
